detail:
Decisions: Corrected the README troubleshooting guidance to say that a healthy runner= value does not imply the server can launch — the probe verifies npx runs, not that it can fetch the package, and the field outage had a healthy-looking probe throughout; leaving the old 'runner=none is the smoking gun' framing would send the next person down the wrong path
Findings: State for the next session: fix/deep-review-2026-07 is merged to main (fast-forward), main is 13 commits ahead of origin and NOT pushed. Full suite 110 files / 1466 passed / 2 skipped. Plugin is 1.24.0 (carries both the agent-frontmatter fix and the launcher fallback). package.json is still 2.5.0, so the six server-side high-severity fixes and the housekeeping archive:false opt-out remain unreleased to npm.; IN FLIGHT: a Workflow (run wf_b584090d-c82) is designing the NL parser fix empirically — three candidate approaches each measured against the real 400-decision corpus plus adversarial NL strings, then judged on correctness and shipping pragmatism. Results not yet returned. Journal at .claude/projects/.../subagents/workflows/wf_b584090d-c82/journal.jsonl.; need: after the parser fix, the next queued items are the graph entity scope last-writer-wins data loss (needs a semantics decision: accumulate a set, first-writer-wins, or drop scope from file entities) and the archive cold-tier design (measured horizon is 2-3 days at ~250 archivable entries/day, so threshold tuning is a palliative and a queryable cold tier is the durable fix).
summary: Session state: main merged and 13 commits ahead of origin, plugin 1.24.0 cut, parser-fix design workflow still running
